children: Build-A-Bear Workshop reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $115.29M, down from $124.25M a year earlier, and diluted EPS of $0.7 versus $0.94 in the prior-year quarter. Net income was $8.76M, compared with $12.37M in the prior-year period.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Consolidated revenues declined mid-single digits year-to-date, driven by lower existing-store and e-commerce sales despite new store openings.
E-commerce remains the company's largest single channel but digital demand softened; wholesale (commercial) activity provided partial offset.
Brand expansion efforts continue into collectibles, licensing, content and gifting to broaden appeal to teens and adults.
Net global locations increased to 674 through corporate, partner-operated and franchise models, with focus on tourist, shop-in-shop and Discovery formats.
Operational initiatives include supply-chain diversification (notably a shift toward Vietnam), tariff monitoring, IT investments and capital projects to support omnichannel and international growth.
